findings.description: Twenty restored front spaces have no explicit fixtures in the current lighting rosters. Prioritize galleries and waiting bay; narrow storage alcoves can receive appropriate spill. Reuse accepted native fixture family, add physical supply and retained room controls.

The compact label mirrors teletype.ink.text, which is progressively printed. Earlier frame caught the title before its final character; later capture displays the full title. No anchoring change justified.

Legacy test hardcodes 210 saved controls and predates generic mechanisms and the lobby emitter. Replace fixed obsolete census and old player-toggle proof with source-roster and actual manipulation/reconstruction coverage; do not claim this stale test passes.
